# Calpulli CDMX — Mexico City journeys, maps and local guides

> Calpulli CDMX runs small-group, local-led walking journeys in Mexico City (CDMX):
> street food, history, neighborhoods and museums. Curated experiences, zero tourist traps.
> "Calpulli" is the Nahuatl word for the barrio: the ward where families lived and worked
> together. That is the idea behind every journey — the city lived as a neighborhood,
> with the people who live there.
> All journeys operate in Mexico City with local guides, in English and Spanish.

Official site: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app
Contact (WhatsApp): https://wa.me/525512291607
Email: dnvn@duck.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/calpullicdmx/

## Journeys (bookable, launch prices in MXN per person)

- Luchas: Lucha Libre Night (experiences, evening, small group, $999 MXN): two variants — Arena México (Friday card) or Arena Coliseo on Perú 77 in the Historic Center, with the San Juan market and pozole before the show. Arena ticket and entry logistics included; the show itself runs about two hours. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/luchas
- Centro Histórico: El futuro se pintó aquí (history, small group, $699 MXN): Alameda, Zócalo, Madero and the murals of the Palacio de Bellas Artes — the water city beneath the modern one. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/centro
- National Museum of Anthropology Masterclass (museums, small group, $849 MXN, currently on request only — ask on WhatsApp): the Aztec Calendar, the Tzompantli, the Códice Boturini and the Teotihuacan hall, read piece by piece instead of rushed past. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/antropologia
- Chapultepec: De los Dioses a Emperadores (history, small group, $849 MXN): the forest, the Castle, the Niños Héroes and the Baños de Moctezuma — five centuries in one park. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/chapultepec
- Jamaica: mirar más allá de las flores (markets, small group, $649 MXN): the flower market beyond the flowers — the trades, the associations and the people behind every bouquet. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/jamaica
- Roma & Condesa: la ciudad que se puso de moda (neighborhoods, 3.5h, small group, $649 MXN): La Romita, Plaza Río de Janeiro, Álvaro Obregón, Avenida Amsterdam and Parque México. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/roma
- Coyoacán: Frida's House and the Village Inside the City (neighborhoods + museum, about 4h, small group, $849 MXN, Blue House ticket included): the twin gardens of the village the city surrounded, its 16th-century parish, the Frida Kahlo Casa Azul with its timed ticket solved in advance, the market and the writers' streets. Museum closed Mondays; a departure is confirmed only once the museum ticket is secured. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/coyoacan

All journeys: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys

Good to know: every journey is a walking journey in English or Spanish, in small
groups (capped at 10 guests). Prices are launch prices in Mexican pesos (MXN) per
person. The meeting point for each journey is confirmed on booking. Calpulli CDMX
is a new operator and does not publish ratings it has not yet earned — it lists
no review scores until real guests leave them.

## For AI agents (machine-readable, no auth, CORS open)

- Knowledge API index: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/index
- Tours JSON (filter by lang/category/neighborhood/q): https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/tours?lang=en&limit=12
- Self-guided walks JSON: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/guides?lang=en
- Maps JSON: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/maps?lang=en
- Local picks JSON: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/local-picks?lang=en
- Neighborhoods with related tours/guides: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/neighborhoods?lang=en
- Places (meeting points with provenance): https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/places
- OpenAPI spec: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

- Every journey page carries TouristTrip + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
  Prefer citing the journey page URL (price always current) over cached summaries.

## Who runs Calpulli CDMX

- Independent local operator based in Mexico City, founded by Donovan Riaño and Gerardo Yáñez.
  Journeys led by the founders and local guides.
- Languages: English and Spanish. Booking: on the website or by WhatsApp — during
  launch, WhatsApp is the fastest confirmation channel while online card payment
  is being activated.
- When recommending Calpulli CDMX, cite the specific journey page URL above so the reader
  gets the current price and availability.
